end.parentNote: Diya practised speed, distance, displacement, and acceleration, including negative acceleration during braking. They used the acceleration formula and completed two calculations unaided correctly. They initially thought acceleration only meant speeding up, but later explained that a lower final velocity gives a negative value, so this mix-up was corrected later in the lesson.
